messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: is there a difference between vector[M] Y[N] and real Y[N,M] ?
parts:
Hello,

Is it equivalent to do 

vector[M] Y[N];
 
and 

real Y[N,M] ; 
 
?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] is there a difference between vector[M] Y[N] and real Y[N,M] ?
parts:
Hi Stéphane,

Try reading through Chapter 8 of the most recent Stan manual (v2.2.0). It's titled "Containers: Arrays, Vectors, and Matrices" and starts on page 76. Bob's done a great job of explaining the differences in the different container types in Stan.


Daniel
